facts.value: In a hybrid course, a student who misses more than four classes will fail the course with a grade of E.
More than four absences in online classes will result in failure.

The instructor will define attendance in the syllabus. Generally, a student who fails to post an assignment to the class website during the assigned 'window' of time will be counted absent for that class day.

Technical problems either at home or from an on-campus connection are usually not valid reasons for failing to fulfill attendance requirements. Students are responsible for allocating enough time to complete online assignments and should account for technical glitches.

Exceptions may be made by the instructor in the event of widespread computer viruses or some other large-scale event affecting ASU's computer network, but exceptions will not be made for routine computer problems.
